title: CodeXX component manifest
description: Manifest for a reusable Luau component published to the CodeXX rules registry (ADR-083 section 4). A component is a module a rule reaches with require("<vendor>/<name>").

schemaVersion.description: Version of this manifest schema. Only 1 exists.

id.description: ADR-079 identity: vendor.name, both segments lowercase, exactly one dot.

kind.description: Distinguishes a Luau component from the tool components ADR-039 ships. Rules read 'codegen'; this reads 'codegen-component'.

vendor.description: Vendor tag. Must match the parent directory name. 'codexx' is reserved to CodeXX-DTDK org members.

name.description: Component name; the second segment of its require() key. LOWERCASE ONLY, deliberately: two names differing in case are one file on Windows and macOS and two on Linux, so a mixed-case name would resolve differently depending on the consumer's filesystem.

version.description: Component version, semver MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH. Must increase on every content change.

description.description: One sentence describing what the component provides.

license.description: SPDX identifier. Published components are MIT; the bundled LICENSE must be byte-identical to the repo root LICENSE.

requires.description: codegen version constraint, ADR-067 section 2 grammar.

uses.description: Other components this one requires. Components may compose; the validator checks the graph is acyclic and that every consuming rule's uses[] is CLOSED over these, which is what lets the installer stay a flat loop with no solver.

yanked.description: Set true to withdraw this component. The published tag is never deleted.
